description: The bar chart illustrates five different design spaces for parameter-efficient fine-tuning: Increasing, Uniform, Decreasing, Spindle, and Bottleneck. The horizontal axis represents the design spaces, while the vertical axis, which is not labeled, shows the values associated with each design space. The Increasing design space has bars that increase in height from left to right, with the shortest bar on the left and the tallest on the right. The Uniform design space has bars of equal height, indicating a consistent value across all design spaces. The Decreasing design space has bars that decrease in height from left to right, with the tallest bar on the left and the shortest on the right. The Spindle design space has bars that alternate in height, creating a spindle-like pattern. The Bottleneck design space has bars that increase and decrease in height, with the middle bars being the shortest, suggesting a bottleneck effect. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and there are no bars that are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotations.
